author: PieZ
body:
This is my first ever map that I have authored and I am excited to announce that it is ready. The map Harenam is a TDM map that was inspired by both Facility and Injustice. I wanted to focus on rooms to pvp and try to give rooms that are close together different aspects while fighting. Some places with more bow, some with more sword. I am a very new map maker so advice and feedback is always appreciated by me as long as it has to do with game play. 

Author:PieZ

Help:
GrapeSmoothie-Feedback
Seth-Feedback
R_K_Cord-Inspiration and minor feedback

(I am not even sorry for the particles)

replies.author: gobernment
replies.body:
Your map has been denied, I apologize the long wait. You said you'd post more images 21 days ago, however I don't see them. Anyway, here's the feedback.

>Looks like Pharoah's Catacombs from Overcast. A bit cramped in some rooms, and I can see some crowding in lanes when trying to fight (they could be 2 blocks wider out). Otherwise, it could use a little more cover.
>i feel as though the concept of this was executed poorly and therefore resulted in a cramped, empty, basic and unappealing map to my own perspective. if anything i'd suggest some variety as to what concerns blocks used in its production and overall just expanding the map as it seems rather limited to me
>Roof needs removing and the rooms are too empty.
